The conflict: applicant.

Register: "Toledo do Brasil Industria de Balancas Ltda."
Document: "Toledo do Brasil Indústria de Balanças Ltda."

Difference is only accents (Indústria vs Industria, Balanças vs Balancas). Rules say accent differences = same-entity. Best value: the document's accented form? The rule says same-entity, but which best_value? For same-entity due to spelling/accent drift, presumably prefer the document's form since certificate is the legal instrument and accents are correct Portuguese. The rules don't explicitly say best_value for same-entity accent drift, but number/year format differences = same-entity with register's canonical form. For accent differences, the document is the legal instrument; the accented form is more correct. So best_value = document value. I'll go with document's accented form.
